title: Step into Halloween with Lick Creek Park's Haunted Hike
excerpt: The city of College Station Parks and Recreation Department is giving people a chance to get into the holiday spirit a little early with its Haunted Hike at Lick Creek Park.
content:
COLLEGE STATION, Texas (KBTX) - With Halloween around the corner, people are getting their costumes ready and houses decorated for the spooky holiday.

The city of College Station Parks and Recreation Department is also giving people a chance to get into the holiday spirit a little early with its Haunted Hike at Lick Creek Park.

Haunted Hike is a guided night hike for ages 13+ on Friday, Oct. 16 from 6:30 to 9:30 p.m.

The parks and recreation department said the hike will be focused on local cryptids, such as the chupacabra, prairie devils, Gator Man and even the world-famous Sasquatch.

As hikers explore the park under the cover of darkness, hikers may also encounter native wildlife, including bats, snakes, owls and fireflies.

You will have to register for the event by Oct. 16. Tickets cost $15 for residents and $18 for non-residents.

Registration also includes access to a haunted hangout with monster movies, photo props, yard games, s’mores and a souvenir T-shirt.

You can reserve your ticket with the city of College Station Parks and Recreation Department.
